visual.general_description: Four-quadrant infographic on malignant otitis externa with a central ear drawing.
visual.detailed_description: Four-quadrant infographic with dashed dividers on a white background around a central circle holding a cross-section drawing of an ear (outer ear, canal, middle ear and a blue spiral inner-ear structure) with the title text "Malignant otitis externa". Upper-left quadrant, titled "Pathophysiology": green rod-shaped bacteria with tails, a blue arrow toward an ear drawing with yellow dots, and a teal glow with the stacked words "Apoptosis", "Inflammation", "Colonization" joined by downward arrows. Upper-right quadrant, titled "Clinical presentation": icons labeled "Headache, otalgia", "Edema of the external auditory canal", "Facial paralysis", "Purulent discharge". Lower-left quadrant, titled "Complications": icons labeled "Facial paralysis", "Osteomyelitis", "Optic neuritis", "Encephalitis, meningitis", "Affectation of the temporomandibular joint". Lower-right quadrant, titled "Risk factors": icons labeled "Advanced age", "Immunodepletion", "Type 2diabetes mellitus", "High blood pressure", "Chronic kidney disease".
